description.html: Arcadia EarthPro RevitaliseD3 builds on EarthPro-A: it keeps the natural mineral clay, amino acids, carotenoids and bee pollen, and adds magnesium plus low levels of preformed vitamins A, D3 and E. According to the manufacturer, it contains 50,000 IU/kg vitamin A, 5,000 IU/kg D3 and 150 IU/kg vitamin E, with 21.74% total calcium.
Arcadia says the vitamin levels are deliberately moderate and modelled on a small mammal, because very potent powders high in A and D3 carry a risk of overdosing. The 50 g pack is a plastic-free tin.

Lightly dust the food rather than coating it: 1 g of powder per 100 g of food. Discard unused powder after each feed. With correct UV and heat, the manufacturer recommends RevitaliseD3 at feed 8 or 16 of the EarthPro programme. If you keep an animal with no UV or low UV, it can be used at every 2nd or 3rd feed.
Store sealed in a cool, dry place, not in the fridge. It is used alongside EarthPro-A and CalciumPro-Mg, which we also stock in our equipment range.
